## Step 1 — Why the session is stored before return

The token is only a lookup key. Storing the session first guarantees that a request using the returned token can immediately recover its session. Returning first would expose a token before its state exists.

Summary: the write completes before the token escapes, so readers cannot observe a token with no session.
